mentions.name: LookAway
mentions.description: A screen-time wellness app that helps people stay healthier and more productive during prolonged screen use. It detects meetings using mic and camera activity; the next version switches to mic-only detection (the camera caused most false positives) and adds per-app mic identification so users can exclude non-meeting apps, along with tweaks to make it less interruptive.
mentions.audience: People spending prolonged time in front of screens who want to stay healthier and more productive
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on LookAway (https://lookaway.app) to help people stay healthier and more productive during prolonged screen time.
